{{Quote|We know it goes through Poderis, so Orus sector is the place to start.|[[Talon Karrde]] about [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] traffic|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Orus Sector''' was in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Orus included [[Kimanan]], [[Mantessa]], [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]], [[Joiol]], [[Poderis]], and [[Hijarna]].

==History==
During the [[Thrawn campaign]], it was incorrectly believed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] traffic passed through the area. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] hired the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] of the future [[Smugglers' Alliance]] to investigate in the sector. They eventually discovered that Thrawn had tricked the New Republic.<ref name="TLC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], [[Datar/Legends|Datar]], [[Lafra]], [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the Orus sector. Additionally, ''Rebellion'' mistakenly places the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the Outer Rim.
